info.description: Build cache protocol: negotiate/read, store/commit write path, and successful-run markers. Consumers call it through the generated clients in clients/go and clients/ts.
info.title: Putnami Cache Server API

get.description: Advertise the optional capabilities the server supports beyond the v1 baseline.

post.description: Finalize an Action Cache entry once its blobs are uploaded (write path, step 2).
Finalize several Action Cache entries once their blobs are uploaded (batched write path).
Return several small CAS blobs inline in one response (download-batch coalescing).
Report which of a window's freshly built blobs the org must upload (batched write path).
Negotiate cache hits for a batch of keys (read path). With X-Putnami-Cache-Entry-Provenance: v1, each hit with complete metadata also carries producer, producerIdentity and channel.
Resolve a batch of compiler-cache objects by (namespace, id), with small objects' bytes inline; a missing or evicted object is omitted.
Record index rows for compiler-cache objects whose bytes are already in CAS, stamping producer and trust channel from the verified credential.
Read the last successful full-target run marker for a workspace, branch, command list, params hash, and selection scope.
Publish a successful full-target run marker using compare-and-swap semantics.
Report which freshly built blobs the org must upload (write path, step 1).
